units.source_text: 但是，毫无疑问，玻璃公司的老板嘎尔的确是一只让我倍感亲切的河童。

en.t: But there was no doubt that Gael, the president of the glass company, was indeed a kappa who made me feel deeply at ease.

units.source_text: 我和嘎尔常常一起去他参加的俱乐部，度过一个又一个欢乐的夜晚。

en.t: Gael and I often went together to the club he belonged to, and spent one pleasant evening after another there.

units.source_text: 其中一个原因是在这个俱乐部里比在托喀参加的超人俱乐部要更为轻松自在。

en.t: One reason was that this club felt much more relaxed and comfortable than the Superman Club I had attended with Tok.

units.source_text: 而且嘎尔的话虽然不如哲学家马咯的话那么深奥，却让我窥见了一个全新的世界——一个更为广阔的世界。

en.t: And although Gael's words were not as profound as those of the philosopher Mag, they let me glimpse an entirely new world, a far broader world.

units.source_text: 嘎尔总是一边用纯金的羹匙搅拌咖啡，一边愉快的地谈天论地。

en.t: Gael would always stir his coffee with a solid gold spoon while cheerfully talking about all sorts of things.
